storage.multipartUploads.abort: To cancel a multipart upload of a restored object that did not complete.
storage.multipartUploads.create: To create multipart uploads when restoring large objects.
storage.multipartUploads.listParts: To list the uploaded parts of a multipart upload while restoring an object.
storage.objects.create: To write each restored object into the target bucket.
storage.objects.delete: To delete an object being overwritten by its restored version.
storage.objects.update: To update the metadata of each restored object.
